name: balloon_fpr_tests
description: Functional tests for balloon free page reporting (VIRTIO_BALLOON_F_PAGE_REPORTING). The feature is opt-in (EnableFpr) and needs the device to offer the bit: QEMU's balloon defaults to free-page-reporting=false, so run the suite with --device-option virtio-balloon-pci,free-page-reporting=true. All thresholds are derived from the actual RAM size (floor = max(RAM/16, 128 MB), hysteresis band = clamp(RAM/32, 256 MB, 1 GB)), so the suite runs unchanged on any guest size.
